summary: Implementation adds an unconditional FullWorkItemBackButton component at the top of the full work item view. The button renders with an ArrowLeft icon and context-sensitive label ('Back to shaping decision' when shaping context exists, otherwise 'Back to details panel'). Clicking invokes setShowFullWorkItem(false), restoring the details panel. Test coverage confirms the button presence, aria-label, and callback invocation. All authoritative checks passed; changes remain within allowed scope.
